isolation: Separate temporary checkout outside the research workspace; fresh Python virtual environment. Python file reads into the original workspace were rejected by an audit hook.
build: Maven offline tests used the normal dependency cache and the profiler libraries included in src/lib; classpath verified to contain no research-workspace paths.
optional_systems: Magneto and ISResMat interpreter/worker contracts tested with subprocess stubs; model training and inference were not run. SBERT/model/service availability remains an explicit installation prerequisite.
notes: No benchmark data was copied into the isolated checkout; tests generated their own fixtures.
The optional dependency classpath Maven goal was unavailable in the offline cache; Java dispatch checks used the classpath from the successful Maven test run.
COMA/Cupid lexical resources came from the normal local NLTK cache; no resource/model download was performed by the matcher server.
